# Terminal links

A [label with **nested emphasis**](https://example.test/label), a bare secure URL https://example.test/bare, a bare ordinary URL http://example.test/plain, and a www URL www.example.test/path.

This [long linked label crosses narrow rows without leaking into its neighbours](https://example.test/a-long-destination?first=one&second=two), while [mixed-case HTTPS](HTTPS://example.test/case) is accepted too.

Unsupported [script links](javascript:alert(1)), [relative links](docs/page.md), [hostless links](https:path), and FTP ftp://example.test/archive remain visible but inert.

An image remains a fallback: ![diagram](diagram.png).
